original_request: Re-engage lapsed luxury customers in NL for Black Friday

timing.frequency_cap: 1 send per customer per channel per 7 days

assumptions: Mapped 'lapsed' descriptor to At-Risk customer_segment (CRM-native tag).
'Luxury' interpreted as lifetime_value_eur >= 500 per user selection.
'Lapsed' interpreted as no order in the 6 months before Black Friday 2026 (last_order_date before 2026-05-27).
No channel was named in the request, so the brief targets all available channels; the compliance step will filter each customer to the channels they've opted into.
Send window defaulted to Black Friday 2026 (2026-11-27), 09:00-20:00 CET local.
Restricted to account_status = active to avoid sending to inactive or suspended accounts.
Default frequency_cap: 1 send per customer per channel per 7 days; additionally suppress anyone contacted in the last 7 days.
open_questions: Confirm the LTV threshold for 'luxury' — used €500 per the selected option; the team may have a stricter internal definition.
Confirm DPO sign-off for EU→US data transfer to Klaviyo, Braze, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads is already in place for NL audiences.
human_summary: Re-engage active luxury customers (LTV ≥ €500) in the Netherlands who haven't bought since late May 2026, with a promotional Black Friday push on 2026-11-27 across all channels (email, SMS, push, in-app, display, Meta and Google ads). Each customer is filtered down to the channels they've agreed to. Unsubscribed, erasure-requested and consent-withdrawn customers are excluded automatically. Two items to confirm: the €500 luxury threshold and the EU→US data-transfer sign-off.
